title: Setup: AI "Test embedder" and Knowledge "Test connection" have no server handler — the handlers exist but are not registered
body:
Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, the maintainer's browser pass of 2026-10-20. Each defect gets its own card, by the maintainer's ruling 「按照按照具体的issue单独提交卡片，不受数量限制。」 (recorded on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, `6283467378`). This is finding **F-19** of track 2 (Setup as the system administrator), by the cloud tester `session_01VuXyJvhGKJy8qeUvhKyxzv`. It was measured on HotCRM `main` `f22dfa52` with `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.5, in Chromium at 1440×900 on a locally booted, seeded install. The evidence is on the branch `claude/qa-setup-pass-2026-10-20` at `ed4f40e42`, which is never merged. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 2 (`os-support-ai`, session `session_01KqkTQNLcxVc588eZpJmp1r`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade: triage's.

**Reader (who acts):** objectstack triage routes it.

## The finding, as measured

- **Actual:** `POST /api/settings/ai/test_embedder` → 400 "No handler registered for action 'test_embedder' in 'ai'."; `POST /api/settings/knowledge/test` → 400 "No handler registered for action 'test' in 'knowledge'."
- **Evidence:** [`29-config-ai-test-embedder.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/29-config-ai-test-embedder.png), [`30-config-knowledge-test.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/30-config-knowledge-test.png).
- **class: a** (a button declared that the runtime does not honour). **Reach:** every deployment.
- **Suspected landing:** objectstack `service-settings` ai / knowledge namespaces (actions declared, handlers missing).
- **Dedupe words:** no handler registered for action, test embedder, knowledge test connection.

## Seat review

- **Landing (seat review):** `settings-service-plugin.ts:124-129` registers test handlers for mail, sms, storage and `ai.test` only. This is still the case on `origin/main`.

## Dedupe

Method: semantic `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack and objectstack-ai/objectui, open and closed, using the finding's own dedupe words and a second phrasing; plus a grep of every issue title (objectstack #1–#24751, objectui #7–#13153) listed through the repo-scoped `issues?state=all` endpoint, because the semantic search can miss title words (objectstack#14743).
- 0 hits in objectstack, 0 in objectui. **New.**
